selected_candidate.name: intraday_bipower_jump_variation_share_238m
selected_candidate.economic_hypothesis: A larger completed-session discontinuous repricing component relative to total minute quadratic variation can indicate concentrated information incorporation whose attention and price discovery continue over the next three sessions.
selected_candidate.formula: Form 119 adjacent log-close returns separately inside each 120-close half, yielding 238 returns and 236 within-half adjacent return pairs. Let RV=sum_{i=1}^{238} r_i^2 and BV=(pi/2)*(238/236)*sum over the 236 allowed pairs of |r_i|*|r_{i+1}|. Return max(RV-BV,0)/RV.
selected_candidate.time_grid: Exactly 09:31-11:30 and 13:01-15:00. The raw 09:30 row remains required by source identity but is excluded. No lunch, overnight, cross-day, or cross-stock return or bipower pair is formed.
selected_candidate.input_rule: Every selected close must be finite and strictly positive. Exact zero returns remain valid. Require all 238 returns and all 236 within-half adjacent pairs; no return or pair may be dropped.
selected_candidate.support_rule: Require RV to be strictly positive and finite and BV to be finite. The mathematical positive part max(RV-BV,0) is part of the sole frozen estimator, not a searched clip or threshold.
selected_candidate.floating_point_rule: Use natural-log float64 arithmetic and the platform pi constant. Require the final score to be finite in [0,1]; canonicalize only values within 1e-12 of zero or one.
selected_candidate.availability: Known at the signal-session close after the exact 240 selected closes; no later session, daily return, comparison value, or Candidate49 observation is used.
